subject: Request: Short trial bridge while PO processes / Medisource
messages:
From: Olivia Price <olivia@medisource.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@medisource.io
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Trial window — procurement delay and request for short bridge

Hi Vivek,

Quick update from our side: Finance got final approval for the purchase this week but our procurement team says the PO will not be issued until after their June 24 audit window (they flagged a vendor onboarding check that pushed them out). We're already deep into evaluation and don't want to lose momentum — can Redwood provide a short-term extension or temporary credits to keep our pilot active while the PO is routed?

Estimated PO ETA: 2027-06-25.

I've attached a brief note from procurement indicating intent to purchase and the internal timeline. Happy to get on a 15-min call if helpful.

Attachment: medisource_po_intent.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Olivia Price
Head of Product
MediSource
olivia@medisource.io
+1 (415) 555-0183
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Price <olivia@medisource.io>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:05:22 -0400
Subject: Re: Trial window — procurement delay and request for short bridge

Hi Olivia — thanks for the heads up and for the procurement note. We're keen to keep the pilot live for you. Two quick asks so we can move fast:

- Can you confirm the primary production contact and whether any additional security evidence (SOC2 cert / subprocessor list) is still outstanding?
- Does procurement require an invoice-first flow, or will a signed PO suffice to trigger billing?

Proposed short-term option: we can provision a 14-day credit top-up that will preserve sandbox capacity while the PO is processed. If the PO comes through before the 14 days expire we'll reconcile and convert to normal billing — if it doesn't, the credit will simply expire.

I'll get finance looped if you confirm the ETA. Kimberly / Sean — can you confirm we can approve a 14-day, ~$4k provisional credit for RDW-4821 and the internal steps? I'll hold off until I have both of them on this thread.

Attachment: provisional-credit-topup.csv (csv) — contains suggested credit amount and usage cap.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (617) 222-3010
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Olivia Price <olivia@medisource.io>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 14:20:38 -0400
Subject: Re: Trial window — procurement delay and request for short bridge

Looping finance: Sean, do we have a standard playbook for 14-day provisional credits for purchase-in-flight situations? If so, please confirm the spend cap and any contract caveats (e.g., credits non-refundable if PO doesn't come through).

From an approvals standpoint, I'm OK with up to $5k provisional credits for trusted pilots where a PO intent exists and procurement email is attached. We should require a short form acknowledgment from the customer confirming purchase intent and PO ETA (Olivia, could you please reply with a one-line confirmation that Medisource will issue PO RDW-4821 by 2027-06-25?).

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Olivia Price <olivia@medisource.io>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, procurement@medisource.io
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 08:03:10 -0400
Subject: Re: Trial window — procurement delay and request for short bridge

Thanks Vivek and Kimberly — confirming here on behalf of Medisource: we will issue PO RDW-4821 by 2027-06-25. Procurement left the audit window in their calendar; they confirmed the legal and vendor checks are the last step.

Security note: our security team asked for an updated subprocessor list; do you have a link or doc you can share quickly? It's not a blocker for the PO but they want it for their file.

We appreciate the provisional credit offer — 14 days will cover the gap if you can provision it this week.

Olivia
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Price <olivia@medisource.io>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, sean_gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 19 Jun 2027 09:01:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Trial window — procurement delay and request for short bridge

Appreciate the confirmation, Olivia — we'll proceed. Recap / next steps: 

1) Redwood will provision a 14-day provisional credit (cap $4,000) tied to account Medisource — activates now and will expire 2027-07-03 if no PO received.
2) Olivia: please forward the procurement intent PDF into this thread (we have the one you attached) and a one-line email from procurement confirming PO ETA (this satisfies our sales-ops check).
3) Kimberly / Sean: please approve the provisional credit in the finance portal and add note RDW-4821 / Medisource.

Kimberly: happy to take a quick call (10–15 mins) if you'd like to review the approval step live.

Also — Olivia, here's a link to our latest subprocessor and SOC2 summary for your security team: https://redwood.example.com/security/subprocessors (public summary). If they need more, I can loop in our security contact.

Thanks all — we'll monitor usage and keep communications tight.

Best,
Vivek
